analysis_refs.heading: Recovered searches
analysis_refs.text: - **NCBI Bookshelf:** ten supported Europe PMC title searches return native NBK book/chapter IDs. Current API fields and core records establish the indexed subset; MED/PMID and NBK identities remain distinct. Chapters retain their parent title without inventing parent IDs. This shares the existing Europe PMC index and is not an additional independent origin. Direct NCBI restrictions remain in force, and reader pages/full text were not fetched.
